subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for macOS Computer Use discovery with these field names and discovery-only permission semantics?
rationale: Once released, plugin authors can depend on this API and host code may consult it around app-owned Accessibility and Screen Recording permissions, so ClawSweeper should not choose the trust boundary without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after owner confirmation
options.body: Regenerate/validate the linked PR’s docs and tests, then merge once plugin, macOS host, and security owners confirm the metadata is discovery-only.

options.title: Revise the contract first
options.body: Change the field names, platform shape, permission enum, or metadata scope before freezing the public plugin manifest surface.

options.title: Pause for host design
options.body: Keep the linked PR draft or close it until the macOS host binding model is firm enough to publish a manifest contract.

recommendation.title: Accept after owner confirmation
recommendation.body: Regenerate/validate the linked PR’s docs and tests, then merge once plugin, macOS host, and security owners confirm the metadata is discovery-only.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history-backed ownership signal for plugin manifest metadata and docs surfaces among the likely owners.
